suggestion.title: Rewrite description and battle line
suggestion.rationale: The old text did not match what the jutsu does. The new text describes its lightning slap and the damage boost it gives the user.

data.description: The user claps their hands until they crackle with lightning, then delivers a thunderous open-palm slap. The charge lingers in their hands, making their next attacks hit harder.
data.battleDescription: Lightning gathers between %user's palms and breaks across %target in one ringing slap, leaving %user crackling with power.

suggestion.rationale: The old text never mentioned the jutsu's second effect: after the slap, the user's own attacks deal 20% more damage for two rounds. The old battle line also said 'his' for every caster and described a 'bright and subtle hit' that 'caresses' the target, which does not fit a thunder slap. The new text shows the lightning slap and the charge that stays with the user to power up their next attacks.
